name: Printy Please (Crucial IT Solutions Ltd)
summary: Small UK retailer in Ipswich (registered as Crucial IT Solutions Ltd, company no. 13682545) specialising in Voron build parts, with a boutique cat-themed sparkle ABS line sold under the Cat Yarn name and its own CatBed PEI build surfaces. Also resells Bondtech and LDO hardware. Filament is a side line rather than the core business.

product_lines.name: Cat Yarn ABS Sparkle
product_lines.notes: Glitter/sparkle-particle ABS in a small colour range; the catalog has no glitter ABS id (pla-glitter is PLA-based), so only the matrix id applies.

additional_notes: Cat Yarn sells at roughly GBP 18-26 per spool, premium for ABS. CatBed PEI spring-steel build surfaces are sold alongside; no specific plate id is claimed here because the surface finish (smooth vs textured) was not established, so plate_ids is left unset. Printy Please also resells Bondtech and LDO parts - a straightforward retail relationship in hardware, not filament, so it is not recorded as an OEM edge. manufacturing_countries is empty: no extruder is named for Cat Yarn and there is no evidence of UK extrusion.

provenance.conflicts: Cat Yarn's extruder is undisclosed; a UK micro-retailer commissioning sparkle ABS almost certainly buys it in, but no supplier was identified.
